lead_raw_text:
The structure of InN crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with a unit cell containing two atoms and one independent Wyckoff orbit. Geometry-derived analysis shows both In and N centers have a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each (6 In and 6 N). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and the supplied polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that 12-vertex In- and N-centered coordination polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces.
